Motorcycle support from Olivedale.

ServTec helps delivery businesses, fleet managers and individual riders with motorcycle sales, servicing and spares from our workshop in Olivedale, Randburg.

Setting up a delivery fleet? Tell us how many bikes you need, what they’ll carry and where they’ll run. Already on the road? Bring us your service schedule, repair list or parts requirements.

Find the workshop ↗

How to get a quote.

A few details help us understand the job.

  1. Choose your service

    Start with rental, maintenance, a repair or a particular part.

  2. Add the useful details

    Include your motorcycle model, fleet size and operating area.

  3. Confirm the scope

    Ask us to confirm availability, terms and what the quote includes before you book.

Before the
next step.

A few practical answers.

Can I enquire about one motorcycle?

Yes. Choose “Repair a motorcycle” or “Find parts or fabrication” and include the make, model and year.

What belongs in a fleet rental enquiry?

Include the number of motorcycles, operating area and intended start date. Ask about available models, rental terms and delivery-box options.

What about on-site servicing?

Include your location and fleet size when asking about on-site servicing. We can discuss whether your location and the work are suitable for an on-site visit.

Can I collect parts from the workshop?

Call or email with the motorcycle model and part number before travelling so you can check stock and arrange collection.

you need?
